summary: orders-api: pick how we validate request bodies
description:
`POST /orders` in src/server.js stores whatever JSON arrives. Last week a client sent `quantity` as a string and the nightly invoice job crashed on it.

We want every write endpoint validated before we add the next three (refunds, returns, addresses). Nobody has picked a validation library for this service yet. Recommend one, and why, before anyone builds it.

comments.author: marcus.webb@northwind.dev
comments.body: Whatever we pick should give clients an error that says which field is wrong.
